description: This file defines the FilterMatcherProjectEvent class, which extends an event class related to project filtering. It includes properties and methods for handling a Matcher and a Project, and provides access to the current user via the session.

classes.name: FilterMatcherProjectEvent
classes.description: An event class that encapsulates a Matcher and Project for filtering projects, with access to the current user.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a Matcher and a Project.

methods.name: getMatcher
methods.description: Returns the Matcher associated with this event.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the current user from the session.
